title: Manage games
subtitle: Edit display information and settings for implemented games.
name: Game name (Vietnamese)
destinationHint: An app path, e.g. /games/typing-rush. The language prefix is added automatically.
error: Unable to complete the request. Check your input and try again.
uploadError: Unable to upload. Choose an image up to 5 MB.
imageHint: Images up to 5 MB. Upload a file or paste a URL.
reorderHint: Use the arrows to reorder; smaller numbers appear first.
englishHint: Leave English fields blank to use the Vietnamese content.
scoresSubtitle: Review student game sessions and scores.
statisticsSubtitle: Understand how students use the games.
fixedImplementation: Game codes and destinations are managed by the application. Admins cannot create games.
configHint: Applies to new sessions. Hearts are based on spawned words and only increase lives up to the maximum.
minWordCountHint: Between 1 and 500. Players must select enough valid, unique words.
settingsError: Unable to save. Check the configuration values and try again.
initialFallSpeedHint: Between 10 and 300 px/second. Speed increases as you play longer.
spawnIntervalHint: Between 300 and 10,000 ms; 1,000 ms = 1 second. Words appear faster at higher levels.
heartEveryWords: Words spawned before each heart word
heartEveryWordsHint: After every N regular words spawn, the next word has a heart, whether typed correctly or missed. Typing a heart word grants one life, capped at maximum lives.
meaningDurationSecondsHint: From 1 to 30 seconds after a correct word. Applies to new sessions; pausing the game also pauses this timer.
maxLivesHint: From 1 to 10, at least the initial lives. Heart pickups never exceed this limit.
